hr_face.abnormal: select sum(qty) as count from itsec_face_dartofacedbstatus where status<>'1'
hr_face.normal: select sum(qty) as count from itsec_face_dartofacedbstatus where status='1'

hr_door.abnormal: select sum(qty) as count from itsec_door_dartodoordbstatus where status<>'1'
hr_door.normal: select sum(qty) as count from itsec_door_dartodoordbstatus where status='1'

face.abnormal: select count(*) as count from itsec_face_offline where status='0'
face.normal: select count(*) as count from itsec_face_offline where status<>'0'

perm.abnormal: select count(distinct ter_no) as count from itsec_face_facedbtoterminalstatus where status='0'
perm.normal: select count(distinct ter_no) as count from itsec_face_facedbtoterminalstatus where status='1'

camera.abnormal: select count(*) as count from itsec_camera_offline_test where status<>'1' and (excludecamera is null or excludecamera='');
camera.normal: select count(*) as count from itsec_camera_offline_test where status='1'
camera.exception: select count(*) as count from itsec_camera_offline_test where status<>'1' and (excludecamera is not null and excludecamera!='')
camera.covered: select count(*) as count from itsec_camera_offline_test where status'2' and (excludecamera is null or excludecamera='');

cameraexception.abnormal: select count(*) as count from itsec_camera_offline_test where status<>'1' and (excludecamera is not null and excludecamera!='')

nvr.abnormal: select count(distinct ipaddress) as count from itsec_nvr_offline where status<>'1'
nvr.normal: select count(distinct ipaddress) as count from itsec_nvr_offline where status='1'

accesscontrol.abnormal: select count(distinct ipaddress) as count from itsec_door_offline where status<>'1'
accesscontrol.normal: select count(distinct ipaddress) as count from itsec_door_offline where status='1'

detail.face: select name,ter_no,ipaddress,round(offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_face_offline where status='0' order by updatedate
detail.hr_face: select name,qty,TO_CHAR(updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_face_dartofacedbstatus where status<>'1' order by updatedate
detail.hr_door: select name,qty,TO_CHAR(updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_door_dartodoordbstatus where status<>'1' order by updatedate
detail.perm: select name,ter_no,ipaddress,sum(qty),TO_CHAR(updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_face_facedbtoterminalstatus where status='0' group by name,ter_no,ipaddress,updatedate order by ter_no
detail.camera: select b.name nvr_name,a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.name,a.ipaddress,round(a.offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(a.offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(a.updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate,a.excludecamera ,a.remark from itsec_camera_offline_test a inner join itsec_nvr_offline b on a.nvr_ip =b.ipaddress where a.status<>'1' and (excludecamera is null or excludecamera='') order by a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.updatedate
detail.camera_offline: select b.name nvr_name,a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.name,a.ipaddress,round(a.offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(a.offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(a.updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate,a.excludecamera ,a.remark from itsec_camera_offline_test a inner join itsec_nvr_offline b on a.nvr_ip =b.ipaddress where a.status='0' and (excludecamera is null or excludecamera='') order by a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.updatedate
detail.camera_covered: select b.name nvr_name,a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.name,a.ipaddress,round(a.offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(a.offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(a.updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate,a.excludecamera ,a.remark from itsec_camera_offline_test a inner join itsec_nvr_offline b on a.nvr_ip =b.ipaddress where a.status='2' and (excludecamera is null or excludecamera='') order by a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.updatedate
detail.cameraexception: select b.name nvr_name,a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.name,a.ipaddress,round(a.offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(a.offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(a.updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate,a.excludecamera,TO_CHAR(a.excludecreatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as excludecreatedate,TO_CHAR(a.excludeupdatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as excludeupdatedate  ,a.remark  from itsec_camera_offline_test a inner join itsec_nvr_offline b on a.nvr_ip =b.ipaddress where a.status<>'1' and (excludecamera is not null and excludecamera!='') order by a.nvr_ip,a.nvr_cameraid,a.updatedate
detail.nvr: select name,ipaddress,round(offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_nvr_offline where status='0' order by updatedate
detail.accesscontrol: select name,ipaddress,round(offlineminute::numeric/60,1) hours,TO_CHAR(offlinetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as offlinetime,TO_CHAR(updatedate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_door_offline where status='0' order by updatedate

sub_detail.sub_perm: select name ,ter_no ,ipaddress ,deptcode ,userid ,username ,TO_CHAR(trantime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as trantime ,status ,TO_CHAR(synctime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as synctime ,remark from itsec_face_facedbtoterminalstatusdetail where (ter_no = $1) and status='0' order by updatedate
sub_detail.sub_hrface: select deptcode ,userid ,username ,TO_CHAR(trantime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as trantime ,status ,TO_CHAR(synctime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as synctime ,remark  from itsec_face_dartofacedbstatusdetail where SUBSTRING(deptcode,1,4) = SUBSTRING($1, 1, 4) and status<>'1' order by updatedate
sub_detail.sub_hrdoor: select deptcode ,userid ,username ,TO_CHAR(trantime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as trantime ,status ,TO_CHAR(synctime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as synctime ,remark  from itsec_door_dartodoordbstatusdetail where (deptcode = $1) and status<>'1' order by updatedate

allQueries.all_hrface: select deptcode ,userid ,username ,TO_CHAR(trantime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as trantime ,status ,TO_CHAR(synctime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as synctime ,remark from itsec_face_dartofacedbstatusdetail where status<>'1' order by updatedate
allQueries.all_hrdoor: select deptcode ,userid ,username ,TO_CHAR(trantime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as trantime ,status ,TO_CHAR(synctime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as synctime ,remark from itsec_door_dartodoordbstatusdetail where status<>'1' order by updatedate
allQueries.all_perm: select name ,ter_no ,ipaddress ,deptcode ,userid ,username ,TO_CHAR(trantime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as trantime ,status ,TO_CHAR(synctime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as synctime ,remark from itsec_face_facedbtoterminalstatusdetail where status<>'1' order by updatedate

getTimes.camera: select TO_CHAR(max(updatedate), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updatedate from itsec_camera_offline

queries.it_contact: select * from itsec_itcontactlist where status='1' order by function
